final.summary: Outfall pH stayed near neutral through the treatment interval, showing no raw alkaline water reached the outfall. ETP inflow was continuous and power matched the load expected for that inflow, with no replay in the power feed. The tank balance closed within tolerance, showing arriving water was accounted for by ETP inflow plus storage. Outfall flow was missing for most of the interval, so flow-based checks there cannot be made.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels). Tank balance: wastewater arriving (estimated from intake) vs ETP inflow + storage change; unaccounted water left the tank another way, or was intake water that never became wastewater. null means a required signal is under 80% coverage.
